# Theme regression fixtures

These are test inputs, not published themes: there are no real-TV screenshots.
The coloured fixture uses the existing `themes/aurora/wallpaper.jpg` artwork.
The regression test materializes all three under ignored `work/theme-fixtures/`,
copying that image into the coloured theme so the exact inputs can be pushed.
See [device checks](../../../docs/theme-everywhere.md#device-checks).
